reviews.text: After having a tough time with several pool cleaning companies that didn’t meet our expectations, we decided to try a new pool service in Grand Prairie. Living out of town made it difficult to know if our pool was really being cleaned and cared for properly. Since making the switch, the experience has been fantastic. The team sends us clear photos of our pool after each service and provides detailed updates about the cleaning and any maintenance they perform. They also helped us with a patio and hardscape remodel, and the results are outstanding. We’re really happy we chose this pool cleaning company!
reviews.author: Dale28 G

reviews.text: Our first experience with Grand Prairie Service for pool cleaning was truly outstanding! From the very beginning, Braden offered helpful advice and tips during the initial visit, making sure our ideas for the pool’s upkeep were practical and effective. Throughout the entire process, communication was top-notch—they kept us updated at every step, and Braden was always ready to answer any questions we had. The cleaning and maintenance were handled with great care and attention to detail. The team followed the schedule perfectly, kept the area tidy, and were always polite and respectful. The pool looked absolutely beautiful after their work—sparkling clean, with the water crystal clear and the surrounding area neat and inviting. Even after the first cleaning, the team provided excellent follow-up service. They gave us a thorough walkthrough on pool care, and have quickly responded to any questions since then. It’s obvious they truly care about customer satisfaction. We highly recommend Grand Prairie Service for anyone looking for reliable and professional pool cleaning. Their expertise and dedication make them stand out, and we’re excited to continue using their services in our next home!
reviews.author: Bianca7 O

reviews.text: Grand Prairie Service was quick to respond and scheduled my pool cleaning for the very next day. Braden, who came out to do the work, was friendly, efficient, and made sure everything was spotless before leaving. I highly recommend their service and plan to use them again. I also had them install a brand new automated pool system, and it's working perfectly—it’s so convenient and easy to use. The team is always fast and responsive, which is something I really appreciate, especially with the hot Texas weather. I’ll definitely keep using their pool cleaning and maintenance services.
reviews.author: annabelle arellano

reviews.text: had a fantastic experience with this pool service team in grand prairie! they installed a new pool system board for me, and the technician, john, really knew his stuff. he walked me through setting up the mobile app for my pool, which made things so much easier. their prices were way better than other pool companies i checked out. while john was here, he also took care of a semi-annual filter cleaning, which was super convenient. the office staff was really friendly and always kept me updated on when they’d arrive. overall, top-notch pool service—i’m definitely sticking with them!
reviews.author: devon boyer

reviews.text: We recently needed new pool lights installed along with some other pool repairs, and Grand Prairie Service really came through for us. Nolan was extremely responsive and made sure we were happy every step of the way. The electrician, Geoffrey, explained everything about the electrical work and even helped reprogram the lights with us after the repairs, making the process simple and stress-free. Braden, who regularly takes care of our pool, always does a great and dependable job. He even let us know right away when there were issues with our equipment, so nothing ever gets missed. It's really comforting to have such a reliable team keeping our pool in great shape, especially with the hot Texas weather.
reviews.author: Margaret Nunez

reviews.text: I really can't say enough good things about the team that takes care of our pool. The name says it all—these folks are truly epic when it comes to pool service. We’ve had several projects done with them, and after they finished our pool renovation, I had to leave a review. Before starting, we talked through everything in detail, making sure they understood what we wanted and what the pool needed. The job was to update our outdated pool area and make it look fresh and timeless. The pool itself didn’t need much work, but the old tile around it and the worn-out decking did. They replaced the dated tile with beautiful new stone, updated the coping, and even installed a custom feature wall with a waterfall. They also set up new lighting and made sure all the wiring was hidden for a clean look. The whole area now looks amazing, and it’s perfect for relaxing in the Texas heat. Throughout the project, Braden and the crew kept us updated, answered all our questions, and always cleaned up before leaving each day. Super professional from start to finish. I’ll definitely use their pool service again and highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable pool care.
reviews.author: Oscar C

reviews.text: I have been using Grand Prairie Service for over 10 years to take care of all my pool cleaning and maintenance needs. They have helped with everything from rebuilding my pool pump and cleaning the filters, to keeping my pool sweep in top shape and making sure I always have the right chemicals. Braden and his team are really knowledgeable and always take the time to explain any pool issues and the best ways to fix them. One person focuses on equipment repairs, while another handles visits to customers’ pools, and there is also someone in the shop to help with supplies. Even when pool products have been harder to find or prices have gone up, they have always managed to keep my pool sparkling clean and well-maintained. I am grateful for their dedication and great service, especially during these challenging times.
reviews.author: Don12 W

reviews.text: The pool project at my home in grand prairie was completed right on schedule, which was great. Now that we've had the pool up and running for a while, i can say we're happy with how things turned out overall. The whole team did a good job keeping the worksite tidy, and most of the contractors were respectful of my property. The pool looks great and we've enjoyed using it, especially with the hot texas weather. The equipment is working well, and my family appreciates having a clean and fun backyard space to cool off in. Geoffrey, who helped with the project, made sure to follow up and address any questions i had about the setup. When there was a small issue with the ground wire for the pool, the team responded quickly and fixed it right away, which gave me peace of mind about safety. There were a couple of things i noticed during the process, like some small leftover parts and a skimmer door that needed a little extra attention. The pool tech walked me through everything during the pool school, and even though i had a lot of questions as a first-time pool owner, everyone was patient and helpful. I learned about pool chemicals, equipment, and regular maintenance, which made me feel confident about taking care of the pool. Even the lounge chairs that came with the pool worked well after i gave them a quick cleaning. Everything arrived as expected, and the team made sure i had all my pool accessories after the finishing touches. Overall, we are very thankful for our new pool and the great job the crew did. I would recommend this pool service to anyone in grand prairie looking to upgrade their backyard.
reviews.author: Teresa Gillespie

reviews.text: Grand Prairie Service has refinished two of my pools, and I got help from Geoffrey to choose the right finish for both. I’m very happy with how everything turned out. I highly suggest using their team for regular pool maintenance too. The weekly cleaning and service are always done on schedule, and I haven’t run into any issues. I’ve even told friends about them, and they’ve been just as satisfied with their pool care.
reviews.author: Liliana Gutierrez

reviews.text: Grand Prairie Service helped us design a fantastic pool, and the team built it with great care and attention to quality. The whole process went smoothly and was finished right on schedule, which really impressed us. Ever since our pool was completed, we've relied on their weekly pool maintenance, with Geoffrey leading the way. Geoffrey is always patient and full of helpful advice whenever we have questions, especially since this is our first pool. The customer service has been outstanding every step of the way. Everyone we've worked with truly knows their stuff and takes pride in doing a great job.
reviews.author: Micah Chen

reviews.text: We have used Grand Prairie Service for our pool cleaning for quite a while now, and our water always stays sparkling clear and fresh. I would absolutely recommend their team to anyone who wants their pool looking its best. They also handled a pool remodel for our neighbors, with Nolan making sure everything was taken care of every day. Their pool looks fantastic now too.
reviews.author: Teresa Howell

reviews.text: We recently had a visit from the team, and they quickly figured out exactly what needed to be done for our pool. In my opinion, this is the best pool cleaning company you can trust. I pay close attention to details, and I’m truly happy with their service. Knowing that our pool is always sparkling and ready for use gives me real peace of mind, especially with the hot Texas weather. For years, they’ve been reliable for us, handling everything from repairs and upgrades to weekly pool cleaning and maintenance. Whenever we’ve had a question or needed help, Geoffrey and the crew are always quick to respond, fair with their pricing, and they consistently deliver great results. When you’re making an investment like a pool, it’s important to have a trustworthy, established company that stands by their work and honors their warranties.
